summary: The repository settings declare a second ruleset, evidence-tags: refs/tags/evidence/** cannot be deleted, moved or force-pushed, with no bypass actor; only scripts/evidence-gc turns its enforcement off, around its own tag deletions.

replay.detail: Repository settings only; no record, signature or verifier rule changes.

rules.detail: Once applied, a pushed evidence record can no longer be deleted or moved by any writer, so a newer failing record cannot be removed to let an older pass decide again. Creating records is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Producers only create tags; nothing in CI deletes or moves one.

manual.detail: An administrator applies the ruleset (Factory), after the evidence-gc lock window has merged, and writes its id into the lock config on the GC host.

recovery.detail: Set the ruleset's enforcement to disabled, or delete it.
